name: [KYA] DENY spike
message: More than 20 KYA DENY verdicts in 5 minutes. Check the top deny reasons on the Shield KYA dashboard. Needs a custom APM retention filter on service:shield-kya-cli. Add your @-notification handle here.

name: [KYA] Never-list hit (destructive tool blocked)
message: An agent called a never-list tool (for example a DROP TABLE style admin tool) and KYA denied it (reason NEVER_EVENT). Review the session on the KYA receipt. Add your @-notification handle here.

name: [KYA] No verdict spans for 30 minutes
message: No KYA verdict spans arrived in 30 minutes. Either export broke or no agent ran. Only meaningful with the MCP gate or gateway: hook-only setups export DENY and REQUIRE_APPROVE spans only, so silence can be normal. Add your @-notification handle here.
